bullets.text: A two-foot-wide sinkhole formed on Velachery Main Road near Nehru Nagar, causing traffic disruption and requiring immediate repair by authorities.
A water tanker truck rammed a motorcycle near Chennai, killing a 63-year-old woman and injuring her husband, with the driver held by police.
Schools in Chennai and Thiruvallur districts remain closed on November 2 due to heavy rain forecasts and the approach of Cyclonic Storm Murasu.
Minister Puski Anand inaugurated a marathon competition in Besant Nagar organized by the Federation of Tamil Nadu Traders Associations to raise drug abuse awareness.
Performers from the Sharulaya troupe presented a Puliyattam folk dance during the Tamil Nadu Day celebrations held at Elliot's Beach in Besant Nagar.
Students and parents expressed fear of venomous creatures due to overgrown bushes surrounding the Panchayat Union Primary School near Tiruttani.
Residents near Manavalanagar urged the State Highways department to clear creepers and fix missing concrete slabs on the road over bridge.
Thousands of devotees gathered at the Tiruttani Murugan temple and waited for three hours in the general queue to have darshan.
Marine Electricals secured a 393.52 crore rupee order bundle from four clients including data center operators Web Werks and CtrlS Datacenters.
Equinix opened five centers enabling businesses to test liquid-cooled artificial intelligence hardware inside working data centers.
Greater Chennai Corporation Commissioner GC Sameeran inaugurated a mobile kidney screening and dialysis vehicle funded by Mobis India CSR.
